name: com.erupt.robot.ufactory
description: UFactory xArm7 with the xArm gripper, ready to drop into an ERUPT scene: wired robot prefab, robot profile and ghost prefab, made with ERUPT's Robot Setup from the description the ERUPT ROS workspace uses. The prefabs use the URDF Importer's components (com.unity.robotics.urdf-importer, installed from the parasollab fork; see the README of com.erupt.core).
